svg.title: What ovat serve does
svg.desc: find_ovms() looks in the config, OVAT_OVMS, PATH and known folders. If OVMS is missing it offers ovat setup at a terminal and refuses otherwise. If found, ovms_env() sets the environment, Popen starts OVMS with logs to a file, and wait_until_ready() watches for progress: ready on health 200, a report if the process exits, a still-running note after 300 s with no progress.

g.text: ovat serve starts the OVMS server.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: find_ovms() looks in the config, OVAT_OVMS, PATH and known folders.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: No, at a terminal: it offers to run ovat setup.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: No, and no terminal: it refuses and downloads nothing.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Yes: ovms_env() sets PATH, PYTHONHOME and LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Popen starts OVMS, with its logs going to a file.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: wait_until_ready() watches for progress. There is no fixed deadline.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Health returns 200: ready. The pid goes in ovms.pid.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The process exited: OVAT reports it and points at the log.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: No progress for 300 s: it says the server is still running.

text.style: font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Find OVMS, set its environment, start it, then wait on progress: ready, exited, or still running.
